AK.measure: Establish Campaign Contribution Limits for State and Local Elections Initiative
AK.shortSummary: Create new contribution limits for state and local campaigns.
Repeal Alaska’s top-four primary and ranked-choice general-election system.

AL.shortSummary: Allow judges to deny bail for certain weapon-discharge and murder-conspiracy offenses.
Prohibit reducing a district attorney’s compensation during the term of office.

AL.measure: Increase Age Limit for Walker County Judge of Probate from 70 to 75 Amendment
AL.shortSummary: Raise the Walker County judge of probate age limit from 70 to 75.

AR.shortSummary: State only U.S. citizens may vote in state or local elections.

AR.measure: Creation of Economic Development Districts Amendment
AR.shortSummary: Allow legislature to create economic development districts and related public-financing programs.
Authorize up to $500 million in bonds for water-related infrastructure.

AR.measure: Right to Keep and Bear Arms Amendment
AR.shortSummary: Expand constitutional language on the right to keep and bear arms.

AZ.measure: Designate Drug Cartels as Terrorist Organizations and Require State DHS to Address Threats Measure
AZ.shortSummary: Declare drug cartels terrorist organizations and require state response.

AZ.measure: Limit Local Tax Rate on Groceries to 2% of Base Price and Require Voter Approval to Increase Tax Rate Measure
AZ.shortSummary: Cap local grocery taxes at 2% and require voter approval for increases.

AZ.measure: Prohibit Taxes or Fees on Miles Traveled in Motor Vehicle Amendment
AZ.shortSummary: Ban taxes/fees based on vehicle miles traveled and related tracking without consent.

CA.measure: Allow Public Financing of Election Campaigns Measure
CA.shortSummary: Allow state and local public-financing programs for campaigns.

CA.measure: Eliminate Successor Election at a State Officer Recall Election Amendment
CA.shortSummary: End successor elections in state-officer recall contests.

CA.measure: Vote Requirements for Initiatives Requiring Supermajority Votes Amendment
CA.shortSummary: Require initiatives that raise vote thresholds to pass by that same threshold.

CO.measure: Notification of U.S. Department of Homeland Security for Certain Criminal Charges and Immigration Status Initiative
CO.shortSummary: Require law enforcement to notify DHS in certain cases involving immigration status and serious charges.

CO.measure: Penalties for Fentanyl Sale and Possession Initiative
CO.shortSummary: Increase penalties and treatment requirements for certain fentanyl offenses.

CO.measure: Prohibit Surgeries for Treatment in Response to Minors' Perception of Sex or Gender Measure
CO.shortSummary: Ban certain surgeries for minors related to gender transition.

CO.measure: Require Life in Prison for Human Trafficking of Minors Measure
CO.shortSummary: Require life imprisonment for child sex-trafficking convictions.

CO.measure: Sex Requirement for School and College Sports Initiative
CO.shortSummary: Require school and college sports participation to align with biological sex, unless co-ed.

FL.measure: Changes to Budget Stabilization Fund Amendment
FL.shortSummary: Increase budget stabilization fund cap and require annual transfers.

FL.measure: Exempt Tangible Personal Property Used for Agriculture or Agritourism from Property Taxes Amendment
FL.shortSummary: Exempt certain farm and agritourism equipment/property from property taxes.

GA.measure: Increase Acre Limit for Agriculture and Timber Conservation Use Property Tax Classification Amendment
GA.shortSummary: Raise CUVA acreage cap from 2,000 to 4,000 acres.

HI.measure: Increase Time for Senate to Act on Judicial Appointments Amendment
HI.shortSummary: Give the Senate more time to act on certain judicial appointments.

ID.shortSummary: Give the legislature exclusive authority to legalize marijuana, narcotics, and other psychoactive substances.
Make English the official state language in the constitution.

IN.shortSummary: Allow denial of bail when the accused poses a substantial risk to others or the community.

IN.measure: Residency Requirements for City and Town Court Judges Amendment
IN.shortSummary: Adjust residency requirements for city and town court judges.

KS.measure: Elections for Supreme Court Justices Amendment
KS.shortSummary: Make Kansas Supreme Court justices elected and abolish the nominating commission.
State only U.S. citizens may vote in state and local elections.

LA.shortSummary: Allow the legislature to add or remove positions from the unclassified civil service.
Add the St. George Community School System to the list treated as parishes for school-system operation.
Repeal certain education funds and direct revenue to the Teachers' Retirement System.
Allow parishes to exempt business inventory from property taxes.
Increase judicial retirement age from 70 to 75.

LA.measure: Raise Income Limit to $150,000 for Special Property Tax Assessment Amendment
LA.shortSummary: Raise the income cap for the special property-tax assessment freeze from $100,000 to $150,000.

MA.shortSummary: Referendum on whether to uphold H.4885, the 2024 firearm law overhaul.

MD.measure: Commission on Judicial Disabilities Vacancies Amendment
MD.shortSummary: Allow temporary filling of vacancies on the Commission on Judicial Disabilities.

MI.shortSummary: Ask voters whether to hold a state constitutional convention.

MO.shortSummary: Renew the 0.1% sales/use tax for state parks and soil and water conservation.
Require the Jackson County assessor to be elected.
Prohibit abortion in most cases and prohibit gender-transition procedures for minors.
Require constitutional initiatives to win a majority in each congressional district and add other initiative-process rules.

NC.shortSummary: Require photo ID for all voters, not only in-person voters.

ND.shortSummary: Create a single-subject requirement for initiated and referred constitutional amendments.
Set legislative term limits at four complete four-year terms regardless of chamber and allow legislative amendment.
Require constitutional amendments to receive 60% approval.

NE.measure: Change State Legislative Term Limits from Two to Three Consecutive Terms Amendment
NE.shortSummary: Extend consecutive legislative term limits from two terms to three.

NM.measure: Board of Regents Nominating Committees Amendment
NM.shortSummary: Change Board of Regents appointment rules and create nominating committees.

NM.measure: Eliminate Governor’s Pocket Veto and Require Veto Explanations Amendment
NM.shortSummary: End the governor’s pocket veto and require substantive veto explanations.

NM.measure: Establish Salary for State Legislators Amendment
NM.shortSummary: Pay state legislators a salary equal to the state’s median household income.
Authorize up to $230 million in bonds for higher-education capital improvements.
Authorize up to $20 million in bonds for library acquisitions.

NM.measure: Repeal Separate Election Requirement for School Election Dates Amendment
NM.shortSummary: Allow school elections to be held on the same dates as partisan elections.
Authorize $30 million in bonds for senior-citizen facility projects.

NV.shortSummary: Second-round vote on adding a constitutional right to abortion before fetal viability.
Second-round vote on requiring voter ID.

OK.shortSummary: Raise the minimum wage to $15 and remove certain worker exceptions.

OR.measure: Increase to Gas Tax, Payroll Tax, and Vehicle Registration Fees Referendum
OR.shortSummary: Referendum on repealing sections of HB 3991 that raised gas tax, payroll tax, and vehicle fees.

SD.shortSummary: Condition Medicaid expansion on federal funding staying at or above 90%.
State that non-citizens are disqualified from voting.
Create an unclaimed property trust fund.

TN.measure: Marsy’s Law Crime Victims Rights Amendment
TN.shortSummary: Revise the constitutional list of crime victims’ rights.
Prohibit the legislature from enacting property taxes.

TN.measure: Remove Right to Bail for Certain Criminal Offenses Amendment
TN.shortSummary: Remove the right to bail for specified serious offenses.

UT.measure: 60% Vote Requirement for Ballot Initiatives to Increase or Expand Taxes Amendment
UT.shortSummary: Require 60% approval for tax-increasing citizen initiatives.

UT.measure: Publication Requirements for Constitutional Amendments Measure
UT.shortSummary: Require constitutional amendments to be published for 60 days before the election.

VA.measure: Use of Legislative Congressional Redistricting Map Amendment
VA.shortSummary: Allow the legislature to conduct congressional redistricting between 2025 and 2030.

VA.measure: Remove Constitutional Same-Sex Marriage Ban Amendment
VA.shortSummary: Repeal the constitutional same-sex marriage ban.
Create a constitutional right to reproductive freedom.

VA.measure: Voting Rights Restoration for Felons Upon Release Amendment
VA.shortSummary: Automatically restore voting rights upon release from incarceration.

VT.shortSummary: Create a constitutional right to organize or join a labor organization for collective bargaining.

WA.measure: Parental Right to Review Education Materials, Receive Notifications, and Opt Out of Sexual-Health Education Initiative
WA.shortSummary: Re-enact parental-rights language from Initiative to the Legislature 2081.

WA.measure: Sex Verification Requirements for Female School Sports Initiative
WA.shortSummary: Require female school sports participation to exclude biologically male students.

WI.measure: Prohibit Government Closure of Places of Worship During Emergencies Amendment
WI.shortSummary: Bar government closure orders for places of worship during emergencies.

WI.measure: Prohibit Government Discrimination or Preferential Treatment Amendment
WI.shortSummary: Ban government discrimination or preferential treatment by race, sex, color, ethnicity, or national origin.

WI.measure: Prohibit Partial Veto to Increase Tax or Fee Amendment
WI.shortSummary: Bar the governor from using the partial veto to create or increase a tax or fee.

WV.shortSummary: State that only citizens may vote in elections.

WY.measure: Homeowner's Primary Residence Property Tax Exemption Initiative
WY.shortSummary: Exempt 50% of a primary residence’s assessed value from property tax for eligible homeowners.
